beats.summary: Dwight attempts to demonstrate the benefits of standing and fitness in the office.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Standing is proven to be healthier, increases productivity and just looks cooler.
Dwight: Last thing I need is luck.

beats.summary: Jim pranks Dwight by throwing money from his wallet and pushing him over.

evidence.snippet: Jim: You know I have to do this.

beats.summary: Robert California introduces his wife Susan to the office staff.

evidence.snippet: Robert: Everyone. I'd like to introduce my wife Mrs. Robert California.
Susan: Hello. Oh call me Susan please.

beats.summary: Dwight promotes his new gym for muscles in the office building.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Well today's your lucky day. I have opened in this very office building Dwight Schrute's Gym for Muscles.
Dwight: Your path from obesity begins right here!

beats.summary: Andy gives a tour of the office and discusses potential job fit for Susan.

evidence.snippet: Andy: I would love to. But I have to be completely honest with you guys. We're 100 percent staffed up.
Robert: Andy. Let's see if there's a good fit first. Then we'll talk.

beats.summary: Office staff interacts with Susan, trying to make her feel welcome.

evidence.snippet: Jim: Well it's sales. So you have to be able to live in the world of rejection.
Dwight: It's the second easiest job in the world. Being a mom.
